Players Committee errata card image of [[Magnetic Suction Tube (PC Errata 2018 E card)]], marked "E", as it stood in the [[Holotable]] image set when the PC's GitHub repository swccgpc/holotable was first committed on 8 July 2018 (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive]).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Light/large/magneticsuctiontube.gif</code> at commit 022435b. Uploaded unchanged. SHA-1 <code>b96a7d0831d624f1f22af42446d39fde6bdf4d3c</code>, SHA-256 <code>4b869157650189264ee386fd6790338d9587efb0f8874c3e06754807174da954</code>.

The card image may be older than 8 July 2018: that is the date of the repository's first commit, which imported the existing image set.

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
